passives.name: Vengeance Is Mine
passives.description: (Passive Effect) Increases Resilience of all allies by 50. Reduces K's damage taken by [Buff_V_tower_apc_5_1_3] while Eva is alive. Recovers K's Weakness Gauge by [Buff_V_tower_apc_5_1_2] at the start of Eva's turn. Increases Priority by [Buff_V_tower_apc_65_1_3] and grants additional effects when Lisha or Snow is defeated. Lisha: Increases Critical Hit Chance until inflicted with Break Snow: Increases Speed until inflicted with Break
